batch_node.name: Grid fixtures dimensions v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Declares the one dimension grid_fixtures writes: tap.playground, the default dimension of the pg_* query-pattern models, the PG_* wildcard edges and the canary collector. Core's dimension-map reshape (tap#708, #711) refers to dimensions by their node's id and never mints a node, so the key must be seeded before a running grid writes these types.

node.name: tap.playground
node.description: Marks query-pattern fixture data: every pg_* model and PG_* edge, and the canary collector's writes, carry {"tap.playground": "gridkin"}, so the Gridkin scenario corpus and the core Gryphon suites can scope to their own fixtures. Test vocabulary only; never production data. The id matches core's test vocabulary for this key.
